description: List inbox posts (posts that have received comments) for the authenticated user. Optionally filter by account, platform, minimum comment count, or updated-since timestamp. Sorted newest first by default (sort_by=date). Use social_api_list_post_comments to fetch comments for a specific post. Supports pagination via cursor. Max 100 results (default 25).

account_id.description: Connected account ID (optional, omit for all accounts)

min_comments.description: Only return posts with at least this many comments

page_id.description: Optional page ID to filter by (for multi-page accounts like Facebook)

since.description: RFC3339 timestamp — only return posts updated after this time

name: social_api_list_inbox_posts
title: List Inbox Posts
